findings.text: follow-on: test_each_driver_helper_returns_a_project_relative_path imports each driver and calls repository_relative directly and test_no_receipt_directory_json_records_a_worktree_path reads the committed JSON, so neither exercises a render route; a call site reverted to str(output) while repository_relative stays defined leaves all three tests green and the next render rewrites a worktree path undetected.

follow-on: repository_relative is copied verbatim into four drivers (also benchmarks/shafranov_pair_receipt.py:70, benchmarks/shafranov_combination_discriminator.py:93, docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/outboard-hole/measure.py:31) and relative_carrier_evidence twice, so the same capability has five owners that can drift and record different forms of one path.

follow-on: a committed receipt under a regenerated directory still contains a path under .reckon-worktrees, excluded from the scan by NON_RENDER_RECEIPTS; the done_when's literal no-committed-receipt condition is met only for render receipts, which the manifest discloses but the scan does not assert.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 1d02798a6; 80b1ebcb4 adds the helpers and rewrites four receipts, 52616c306 adds only the landing fragment, ten files total.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires no committed receipt under the regenerated directories to carry .reckon-worktrees and a test asserting it per render-only route; the scan at tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py:62 asserts the four receipts and the base arm is red, but preflight-receipt.json under a regenerated directory is excluded and route call sites are not exercised.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to make render receipts record project-relative paths and rewrite the committed ones; the four drivers gained repository_relative and the four committed receipts' path fields were rewritten.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states the gate 3 passed at head 80b1ebcb4, red at base, and the importer suite 55 passed/0 added failures, naming gate-head.log, negative-control-base.log, suite-head.log and suite-base.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares the four drivers, the four receipts, tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py and the landing fragment; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py reddens at base and asserts each helper relativises, but reverting a render route to str(output) while keeping repository_relative leaves all three tests green, so route regressions are unguarded (tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py:85).
justifications.evidence: Gate tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py is named by the done_when and its result is recorded in the manifest and gate-head.log (3 passed, EXIT=0) with the base arm red in negative-control-base.log; the route itself is not exercised by the gate, which is recorded as a durability follow-on.
justifications.fit: repository_relative follows the surrounding driver style and carries no forbidden name, but the identical definition is pasted into four drivers (benchmarks/sol_ledger_current_census.py:49, benchmarks/shafranov_pair_receipt.py:70, benchmarks/shafranov_combination_discriminator.py:93, docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/outboard-hole/measure.py:31).
justifications.goal_fidelity: The four committed receipts under the regenerated directories now record project-relative png/svg/receipt and carrier-module paths (docs/figures/forward-solve-api/sol-ledger-census/sol-ledger-render.json; docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/outboard-hole/figure-receipt.json), matching the driver routes that write them.
justifications.reuse: No canonical owner of a repository-relative path form exists (searched nova/ and benchmarks/), but the repository already carries ad-hoc forms (benchmarks/connectivity_route.py:725, benchmarks/exact_placement_discriminator.py:113, docs/figures/forward-solve-api uses str(FIGURE.relative_to(ROOT))) and this change adds four more copies instead of one shared helper.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1d02798a6..52616c306 touches only the four drivers, their four committed receipts, tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py and the landing fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.

limitations: The gate asserts the committed receipts and each helper in isolation; it does not run a render route, so a route reverting to str(output) is not caught.
preflight-receipt.json and the .log/.sh files under the regenerated directories still carry .reckon-worktrees paths; those are outside the reviewed node's write scope and disclosed in its follow_ons.
